sections.heading: Pokies, Tables and Everything In Between on the Gaming Floor

content.text: Each of the Crown Casino resorts runs its own blend of machines and tables, shaped by local licensing rules and the venue's own personality. Below is a city-by-city rundown of what visitors can expect the moment they step onto a land-based gaming floor.
Reels and Rows: The Pokies Line-Up
The land-based Crown Casino pokies collection is enormous, spanning thousands of cabinets, though the count and mix shift noticeably from one property to the next.

items: **Melbourne**: the largest fleet in the network, with roughly 2,628 licensed machines running across the main floor around the clock.
**Perth**: an estimated 2,000 to 2,500 machines, figures that vary slightly depending on the source, spread through a floor known for its riverside setting.
**Sydney**: no public pokies at all, since the Barangaroo property runs as a members-only, table-focused venue.

content.text: Within the Crown Casino pokies themselves, a few formats show up consistently across Melbourne and Perth:

items: **Classic reel machines**: traditional three-reel and five-reel cabinets that keep long-time regulars coming back for a familiar spin.
**Multi-line video pokies**: modern titles with dozens of paylines, bonus rounds and free-spin features built in.
**Linked jackpot machines**: pokies connected across banks of cabinets, building progressive prizes such as the Bad Beat Jackpot or Progressive Payroll.
**Electronic table games (ETGs)**: touchscreen versions of roulette and baccarat that sit between a pokie and a live table, available at both Melbourne and Perth.

content.text: Where the Real Action Sits: Table Games and Premium Rooms
Crown Casino table games section is where the three venues diverge the most, with each city running a noticeably different format and scale.

items: **Melbourne**: the broadest public offering, with around 540 tables including roughly a hundred dedicated to poker, open to any visitor walking in off the street.
**Perth**: somewhere between 220 and 350 tables depending on the estimate, plus a set of named premium salons not found elsewhere in the network.
**Sydney**: a members-only format built around the Crystal Room, running roughly 160 tables and 70 electronic table units, with a minimum stake of AU$20.

content.text: A handful of Crown Casino table games types and premium spaces are worth calling out individually:

items: **Blackjack**: run across all three venues, with betting minimums that vary depending on the room and the city.
**Baccarat**: a mainstay of the premium salons, especially in Perth's dedicated Baccarat Room and Sydney's Crystal Room.
**Roulette**: both European wheels and electronic versions sit alongside the traditional tables, mainly in Melbourne and Perth.
**VIP and high-roller salons**: private rooms with higher limits, extra privacy and dedicated hosts, including Perth's Pearl Room and Riverside Room.

content.text: Perth holds the standout title here, home to a purpose-built poker room that hosts Aussie Millions, one of the country's best-known tournament series, alongside daily cash games and weekly events. Melbourne runs its own cash tables too, folded into that wider set of roughly a hundred poker-capable tables across the main floor. Sydney keeps its poker offering smaller and more exclusive, tucked within the members-only Crystal Room.

sections.heading: From the Couch to the Casino: Games on the Online Platform

content.text: The online arm of the brand works alongside more than 200 software studios, giving players access to a catalogue that dwarfs anything possible on a physical floor.
With well over 18,000 titles across the site, the Crown Casino online pokies range covers everything from nostalgic three-reelers to elaborate cinematic slots.

items: **Jackpot pokies**: titles carrying a shared progressive prize pool, often triggered from stakes as low as 20 cents.
**Exclusive releases**: games built specifically for the platform and not found on rival sites.
**Bonus-buy titles**: pokies letting players purchase entry straight into a feature round instead of waiting for it to land naturally.
**Household names**: crowd favourites such as Queen of the Nile II, Big Red, Miss Kitty and Wolf Gold sit near the top of most popularity lists.

content.text: For anyone missing the feel of a real table, the Crown Casino pokies online platform is only part of the picture, since a full live-dealer suite runs alongside it.

items: **Live blackjack**: multiple tables streamed with real dealers and varying stake levels.
**Live baccarat**: a favourite among the same high-roller crowd found in the land-based salons.
**TV-style game shows**: interactive formats blending a wheel-spin or card-draw with a live host.
**Video poker and standard card games**: digital versions of blackjack and poker for solo play at any pace.

content.text: Beyond Crown Casino online pokies and tables, the platform rounds things out with a handful of quick, casual formats.

items: **Keno and bingo**: fast electronic draws familiar to anyone who's played the pub or club version.
**Scratch cards**: instant-win games for players after a quick result.
**Crash and skill games**: arcade-style formats that reward timing and reaction over pure luck.
**Sports and virtual betting**: a separate section covering the tote, sports markets and virtual racing.

faq.title: Is it cheaper to play Crown Casino pokies online than at a resort?
faq.text: Generally yes, since online stakes can start from as little as 0.20 AUD per spin, well below most land-based minimums. Table games follow a similar pattern, with online tables usually offering lower entry points than the premium rooms in Perth or Sydney. Bonuses and free spins on the platform can also stretch a budget further than a straight cash session on the floor.

faq.title: What table games can I actually play at the resorts?
faq.text: Blackjack, baccarat and roulette form the backbone of the table offering, though the exact spread depends on which resort you visit. Melbourne runs the broadest public floor with around 540 tables, Perth carries dedicated premium salons like the Baccarat Room and Riverside Room, while Sydney sticks to a members-only format inside its Crystal Room. Poker also gets a proper home base at Perth, host to the well-known Aussie Millions series alongside daily cash games.

faq.title: Can I play the same pokies online and in person?
faq.text: Not always, since some titles built specifically for the physical floor use hardware that only exists in the resorts themselves. That said, many popular series such as Wolf Gold, Big Red and 5 Dragons Gold appear in both settings, giving players a familiar option wherever they choose to spin. The Crown Casino pokies online library also carries plenty of exclusive titles you won't find on the casino floor at all.
